meta.title: Lingo - AI In-Game Chat Reply Translator for Multiplayer Games
meta.description: Lingo is an AI-powered in-game chat reply translator for Windows and macOS. Translate your callouts for Dota 2, LoL, WoW, Overwatch 2, and more with one hotkey.
meta.keywords: AI game translator, in-game chat translator, game chat translation, Dota 2 chat translator, League of Legends translator, World of Warcraft translator, Overwatch 2 translator, multilingual gaming chat, Windows game translator, macOS game translator

hero.title: Instant Chat Reply Translation
hero.subtitle: Compose natural in-game replies across Chinese, English, and Russian, then paste them back into chat with one hotkey.
hero.macDetail: Open the DMG, drag Lingo into Applications, and start playing.
hero.windowsDetail: Run the EXE installer and finish setup in a few clicks.
hero.supportLine: Built for Dota 2, LoL, WoW, Overwatch 2, and any game with text chat.

mockup.title: Translate precisely, send instantly
mockup.body: Type your message in Chinese, press the hotkey, and Lingo translates gaming terms like BKB, engage, and hold into natural English — then pastes it right back into chat.
mockup.source: 先别接，等我 BKB 好了我们再打。
mockup.result: Don't force yet. Wait for my BKB, then we take the fight.
mockup.chatDraft: Don't force yet. Wait for my BKB, then we take the fight.
mockup.sideBody: Concise sentences, consistent tone, and low-friction communication for live matches.

features.title: Built for fast, readable team chat.
features.subtitle: Translate, rewrite, and send in-game callouts without slowing the match down.

instant.title: One-key translate
instant.description: Select text or type your message, hit the hotkey, and send the result.

server.title: Context-aware AI
server.description: Server-side models keep the output short, natural, and ready for live matches.

phrases.title: Quick-send phrases
phrases.description: Use ready-made callouts like push, back, wait, and regroup in one tap.

languages.title: Cross-language communication
languages.description: Switch between Chinese, English, and Russian across mixed-language lobbies.

supportedGames.title: Optimized for the games people actually play.
supportedGames.subtitle: Starting with Dota 2, LoL, WoW, and Overwatch 2. If your game has text chat, Lingo fits.
supportedGames.note: If a game has a chat box, Lingo can help you turn short callouts into clearer multilingual replies.

dota2.name: Dota 2
